description: Finance Committee directed to appoint 2026 Chair and Vice-Chair.

chips.text: Five councillors appointed to Finance Committee for 2026.

description: Licenses city land at 86 24th Street East for daycare play area.
Agreement with Produckidvity Childcare Inc. runs February to November 2026.
Daycare pays $2,125 monthly for the temporary space.

chips.text: Daycare needs temporary outdoor play area to meet child care regulations.

description: Committee recommends borrowing up to $125.8 million for six projects.
Funds Water Treatment Plant, Transit, and recreation facilities.
This annual report meets public notice requirements.

chips.text: $7.8M for the Indoor Recreation Facilities Project
No questions or comments were raised by councillors.
Taxpayers will ultimately fund the $125.8 million in borrowing.
Administration will bring back specific borrowing bylaws later.

description: Committee recommends SREDA funding 2026-2029 with 3% annual increase.
Includes $800,000 pilot for business concierge service.

chips.text: New accountability section with KPIs for SREDA's concierge service.
Businesses will benefit from a new concierge service pilot.

description: Committee recommends withdrawing $195,933.86 from Property Realized Reserve.
Funds land development and sales costs for 2024-2025.
Reviews outstanding and completed resolutions from Finance Committee.
